sourcePolicy: Data Dragon is the patch-specific primary source. Wiki mechanics are editorially reviewed with a source URL and must not be represented as Data Dragon facts. Unknown means no sufficiently specific interaction has been established.

interactions.claim: Riot's item text says champion damage with the ultimate triggers Malignance's ground effect; Ahri's R deals champion damage.

source.name: Riot Data Dragon 16.22.1 item.json + Ahri.json

interactions.claim: Shadowflame explicitly affects magic and true damage against low-health enemies; Ahri's current Data Dragon spell descriptions identify magic/true damage. This is a conditional damage effect, not a general spell proc.

source.name: Riot Data Dragon 16.22.1 item.json + Ahri.json

interactions.claim: Current Data Dragon ability text does not establish that Ahri's spells trigger item on-hit effects. Do not infer this from repeated magic damage.

source.name: Riot Data Dragon 16.22.1 Ahri.json

interactions.claim: These items provide mana/AP and/or mana utility that fit Ryze's resource-heavy spell pattern. The bundled Data Dragon profile contains no explicit mana-scaling coefficient, so this is not a verified mana-to-damage formula or item proc.

source.name: Riot Data Dragon 16.22.1 Ryze.json + item.json; editorial review

interactions.claim: Liandry's text triggers its burn from damaging abilities and Cassiopeia's current Q/W/E descriptions deal spell damage. The source does not establish an exact damage multiplier for each spell.

source.name: Riot Data Dragon 16.22.1 Cassiopeia.json + item.json

interactions.claim: Rylai's text says damaging abilities slow. Cassiopeia's Q/W/E are damage abilities in current Data Dragon descriptions. This establishes the trigger category, not per-tick proc rules.

source.name: Riot Data Dragon 16.22.1 Cassiopeia.json + item.json

interactions.claim: Azir's Sand Soldier primary-target attack applies on-hit and on-attack effects at reduced effectiveness; repeated soldier hits do not. Nashor's Tooth has an on-hit attack effect. This does not imply every Azir spell or soldier hit applies it.

source.name: League of Legends Wiki · Azir / Sand Soldiers; Riot Data Dragon item text

interactions.claim: Jinx Q changes her basic-attack modes; critical chance/damage and attack damage support those basic attacks. This is an attack-stat interaction, not evidence that her W/E/R trigger on-hit effects.

source.name: League of Legends Wiki · Jinx; Riot Data Dragon 16.22.1 item.json

interactions.claim: Runaan's explicitly says its bolts apply on-hit effects. Jinx's Q attacks are basic attacks, but this record does not claim rockets create extra bolts or that W/E/R are on-hit attacks.

source.name: Riot Data Dragon 16.22.1 item.json + League of Legends Wiki Jinx

interactions.claim: Do not assume Jinx's non-basic-attack abilities apply item on-hit effects.

source.name: Riot Data Dragon 16.22.1 Jinx.json

interactions.claim: Kai'Sa's reviewed on-hit core is tied to basic attacks and her passive Plasma stacking. This does not claim that Q's missiles, W, or other ability-generated damage apply every item on-hit effect; per-ability application is not established by the bundled Data Dragon text.

source.name: League of Legends Wiki · Kai'Sa; Riot Data Dragon 16.22.1 item.json

interactions.claim: Health and resistances support Ornn's front-line role and his kit's close-range combat. Thornmail is conditional on being hit by attacks and should be justified by enemy attack/healing context rather than treated as a universal best-in-slot.

source.name: Riot Data Dragon 16.22.1 Ornn.json + item.json; editorial review

interactions.claim: Data Dragon explicitly identifies Soraka W/R as healing and these items state healing or shielding an ally as their trigger. Staff/Ardent/Moonstone effects trigger through ally healing; Redemption is an active heal rather than a Soraka spell proc.

source.name: Riot Data Dragon 16.22.1 Soraka.json + item.json

interactions.claim: Dawncore provides heal-and-shield power and mana regeneration; Soraka's current W/R are explicitly healing effects. This is stat/effect compatibility, distinct from an item passive trigger.

source.name: Riot Data Dragon 16.22.1 Soraka.json + item.json
OP.GG published core + local completion; item and ability text from Data Dragon

findings: Malignance has a documented ultimate-damage trigger; Shadowflame is conditional against low-health targets.

Shadowflame plus Void Staff combine flat and percent magic penetration; not automatically redundant, but both occupy offensive slots and should be compared against survivability or sustained-damage options.
The published three-item nucleus and editorial completion are distinct evidence; the six-item set was not observed as one combination.
buildReviews.alternativeContext: Against durable frontline, retain percent penetration only when magic resistance is material; Liandry is an alternative for extended fights, at the cost of burst/penetration.

source.name: OP.GG + local editorial completion; Data Dragon item/ability text

findings: Rod of Ages and Seraph provide mana/resource utility; Data Dragon bundle exposes no explicit mana-to-damage coefficient, so exact scaling is not certified here.
Actualizer's empowered-mana effect is thematically aligned but increases mana cost; this is a meaningful resource tradeoff.
Mercury's Treads and Zhonya answer different threats and should be chosen by composition; the six-item completion is not an observed combination.
buildReviews.alternativeContext: Against heavy physical dive, Frozen Heart may replace a damage slot; against magic burst, preserve a dedicated defensive option. No composition was supplied, so no threat-specific swap is asserted.

source.name: OP.GG + local editorial completion; Data Dragon item/ability text; Riot Patch 26.1 notes confirm the passive change

findings: Liandry and Rylai have documented damaging-ability triggers matching Cassiopeia's spell damage; exact repeat/tick proc behavior is not inferred.

Cassiopeia can buy boots in the current patch: Riot reworked Serpentine Grace in 26.1, replacing the cannot-purchase-boots restriction with increased effectiveness of movement-speed buffs. Swifties are therefore legal; whether the slot is optimal depends on the game.
Rod + Seraph overlap resource investment; its value depends on game length and mana demand. The full set is an editorial completion.
buildReviews.alternativeContext: Against engage/burst, replace a lower-priority damage/utility slot with Banshee or Zhonya; opportunity cost is sustained damage or control.

source.name: OP.GG + local editorial completion; Riot Data Dragon and reviewed Azir mechanics

findings: Nashor is editorially linked to Azir soldier primary-target on-hit at reduced effectiveness; repeat hits do not apply on-hit effects. This is not a universal spell proc.
The build combines attack-speed/on-hit with AP and penetration, so it is a coherent DPS-to-magic-damage direction, but the remaining AP burst items are not individually proven optimal.
Shadowflame plus Void Staff may be justified against low-health and MR-stacking targets, but takes two offensive slots.
buildReviews.alternativeContext: Against frontline, compare Liandry for sustained combat; against dive, retain Zhonya over an additional damage slot.

source.name: OP.GG published core + local completion; Riot Data Dragon and reviewed Jinx mechanics

findings: Jinx Q changes basic attacks; critical chance, AD, and attack speed support that attack pattern. Runaan's bolts explicitly apply on-hit effects.
Infinity Edge and Lord Dominik support crit/physical damage; Guardian Angel trades another offensive spike for survival.
Do not attribute item procs to W/E/R. Six items were not observed together in this local completion.
buildReviews.alternativeContext: Against frontline, preserve LDR; against lethal dive, GA may be appropriate but delays damage. Runaan should be compared with single-target range/damage options based on teamfight needs.

source.name: OP.GG published core + local completion; Data Dragon item text and reviewed Kai'Sa mechanics

findings: Kraken, Guinsoo, Terminus and Blade of the Ruined King share an attack/on-hit direction; the relationship to Kai'Sa's basic attacks is editorially reviewed, not extended to every Q/W missile.
The six-piece set has no separate magic-penetration/AP continuation despite a hybrid alternative existing in another profile; this build is the on-hit variant.
Guardian Angel gives survivability but costs another attack-synergy slot.
buildReviews.alternativeContext: Against high-health frontline, retain BORK; against burst/dive, GA can replace offensive tempo. Do not label this as Kai'Sa's only viable build.

source.name: OP.GG published tank core + local completion; Riot Data Dragon item text

findings: Sunfire, Jak'Sho, Force of Nature and Randuin produce a health/resistance frontline profile.

Thornmail is conditional: it responds to being hit by attacks and is most useful against attack-heavy/healing contexts; this record does not establish those threats, so default inclusion is not fully justified.
The set contains both Plated Steelcaps and multiple armor sources; this may be reasonable against physical teams but is not a universal completion.
buildReviews.alternativeContext: Against predominantly magic damage, replace Thornmail or Randuin with additional MR/health; against crit/attack-heavy threats, preserve Randuin/Thornmail as appropriate. Exact swap requires composition evidence.

source.name: OP.GG published enchanter core + local completion; Riot Data Dragon item/ability text

findings: W/R are healing in current Data Dragon; Moonstone, Ardent, Staff, and Redemption explicitly reference ally heal/shield effects. Dawncore adds heal/shield power and mana regeneration.
Ardent and Staff both reward ally healing but their buff beneficiaries differ by team composition; buying both is plausible, not automatically redundant.
The full six-item set was not measured as a combination. Against hard crowd control, Mikael's is an alternative with a team-utility slot cost.
buildReviews.alternativeContext: Against hard CC, compare Mikael's; against burst, compare Locket. Each replaces a healing/ability-power slot and changes team utility.

source.name: Rift Companion editorial review, current-patch Data Dragon item/ability text

findings: Lich Bane adds an attack-linked component, but no item-proc claim is made here without confirming the exact combat pattern.
The rest of the set remains AP/penetration with Zhonya; the build is structurally compatible but its mobility label alone does not establish superiority.
buildReviews.alternativeContext: Use this when Ahri can safely weave attacks after spells; it gives up a more persistent damage or defensive item slot.

source.name: Rift Companion editorial review, current-patch Data Dragon item/ability text

findings: Keeps percent magic penetration and adds Liandry for longer fights; Shadowflame is conditional against low-health targets.
Void Staff and Shadowflame use two offensive slots for penetration/conditional damage. The set trades Rabadon’s broad AP amplification for sustained-frontline tools.
buildReviews.alternativeContext: Consider this only when confirmed durable targets make fights extended; keep a defensive slot if enemy dive is the greater threat.

source.name: Rift Companion editorial review, current-patch Data Dragon item/ability text

findings: Frozen Heart is a physical-defense option; it is justified against attack-heavy physical threats, not by Ryze’s kit alone.
The set combines three mana/resource items and defensive boots/armor, but does not include Zhonya’s active. Its value is composition-dependent.
buildReviews.alternativeContext: Use against sustained physical attacks; the armor slot delays AP and does not solve magic burst.

source.name: Rift Companion editorial review, current-patch Data Dragon item/ability text

findings: Banshee supplies a spell shield against a qualifying enemy spell; Liandry/Rylai retain the documented damaging-ability effects.
This is a conditional defensive variant. Swifties are legal in current 26.22 after the 26.1 passive rework, but they do not provide magic penetration.
buildReviews.alternativeContext: Against magic burst or one decisive spell, Banshee replaces a damage slot; against physical dive, evaluate Zhonya instead.

source.name: Rift Companion editorial review, current-patch Data Dragon item/ability text

findings: Retains the reviewed soldier/Nashor relationship, with Banshee added against spell engage.
Banshee replaces percent penetration, so this set may lose damage against MR stacking. It is a survival alternative, not a universal upgrade.
buildReviews.alternativeContext: Use when spell engage is confirmed and survival prevents sustained soldier damage; otherwise keep a damage slot.

source.name: Rift Companion editorial review, current-patch Data Dragon item/ability text

findings: Bloodthirster adds lifesteal and a shield effect; it trades Guardian Angel’s resurrection for ongoing sustain.
Retains the crit/attack direction and LDR against armor/bonus-health targets; no win-rate transfer from the other set.
buildReviews.alternativeContext: Choose for repeated fights where healing can be applied; choose GA when one lethal engage is the main risk.

source.name: Rift Companion editorial review, current-patch Data Dragon item/ability text

findings: Mortal Reminder is an anti-heal/crit/armor-penetration option; it replaces LDR, so compare their target-specific effect and do not assume both are needed.
Maintains crit and GA defense; the set is only justified when enemy healing matters.
buildReviews.alternativeContext: Use when healing reduction is a real team need; otherwise LDR can be the more direct damage choice into armor.

source.name: Rift Companion editorial review, current-patch Data Dragon item/ability text

findings: The AP items support Kai’Sa’s magic-damage/passive pattern; Nashor also provides attack speed/on-hit stats.
Kraken and Guinsoo preserve an attack/on-hit base, so this is hybrid rather than full AP. Seraph’s AP/mana utility should not be described as a verified Kai’Sa mana scaling.
buildReviews.alternativeContext: Use the hybrid route only when the AP side is useful for the game; it gives up a more sustained physical/on-hit item and has different penetration needs.

source.name: Rift Companion editorial review, current-patch Data Dragon item/ability text

findings: The set stacks substantial magic resistance and health; Thornmail still adds armor and is conditional against attacks/healing.
Multiple MR sources may be redundant if enemy magic damage is not high, while Thornmail may be low value against a spell-heavy team.
buildReviews.alternativeContext: Use when confirmed magic threats dominate; consider replacing Thornmail with an item that answers the actual damage profile.

source.name: Rift Companion editorial review, current-patch Data Dragon item/ability text

findings: Mikael and Locket add protective active effects; they do not trigger from Soraka healing but can protect allies from CC/burst.
The pair gives up Ardent’s attack-speed/on-hit ally buff and Staff’s AP/haste buff. Item actives require timely use.
buildReviews.alternativeContext: Use against hard crowd control and burst; preserve the healing-buff set when allies can convert it to more value.
